title: build(scenarios): a minimal unpublished build, and a narrow ./score entry that reads no objectql or plugin-sharing
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D6fapbH2zHLk3JPBFybbtnd)_

domain:devx#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cwgUKpQgCE3UWsA74d

Fixes #30915
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:私有包 `@objectstack/scenarios` 加了一个不发布的最小 tsup 构建(`dist/` 下 ESM + CJS + `.d.ts`),四个导出子路径全部指向构建产物;`./score` 改为窄入口,只含图形打分与答题/写操作评分,不再牵出 `objectql` 和 `plugin-sharing`;原先的完整入口改名为 `./score/full`。
- **为什么改**:按裁决 D 打分器搬进了这个包,但包里只有 `.ts` 源码,cloud 打包后用纯 Node 加载会报 ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND;内联打包又等于把源码复制进 cloud(2.87 MB → 3.95 MB),违反裁决。
- **风险与回滚**:包仍是 private、不发布;仓内的测试和 `run-scenarios` 仍直接读 `src/`,行为零改动。唯一外部消费者是 cloud#3604(尚未落地)。回滚即 revert。
- **先看**:① `packages/qa/scenarios/package.json` 的 `exports`(`./score` 与 `./score/full` 的分工);② `src/score/narrow.ts`(只做 re-export,没有搬文件);③ `turbo.json` 一行:本包 `test` 改为先跑本包 `build`。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios build && pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios exec vitest run test/build`,预期 5 个测试全绿。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`@objectstack/scenarios` (`packages/qa/scenarios`) exported `.ts` sources only. A consumer that links the framework tree and bundles its own entry with tsup leaves the dependency external, so plain Node then loads `src/score/index.ts`, whose `.js` specifiers only a TypeScript resolver follows: `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND`, ESM and CJS alike (measured by the cloud#3604 dev; reproduced here, see the ablation below).

1. **A minimal build, still private and unpublished.** `tsup.config.ts` builds one entry per export subpath to `dist/` (ESM `.js`, CJS `.cjs`, `.d.ts` / `.d.cts`, `splitting: false`, dependencies external), using `tsconfig.build.json` (`rootDir: src`). `build` ends with `check-dts-emitted.mjs` (8/8 declarations present). Every `exports` subpath (`.`, `./score`, `./score/full`, `./runner`) now has `import` / `require` conditions on the built files, wired the way `packages/lint` is (a `type: module` multi-entry tsup package; no private package under `packages/` had a tsup build to copy). The suites and `run-scenarios` (`tsx src/runner/cli.ts`) import `src/` relatively and are untouched; no in-repo package imports `@objectstack/scenarios` by specifier.
2. **A narrow `./score` entry.** `src/score/narrow.ts` re-exports `scenario-graph`, `scenario-naming`, `scenario-operation-grade`, `scenario-run-grade` and `scenario-score` (so `scoreGraphShape`, `artifactToEvalGraph`, `gradeRun`, `gradePersonaRun`, `gradeOperation`, …). Its import graph reads `@objectstack/core` and `@objectstack/spec` only. The previous whole entry, `src/score/index.ts`, is unchanged code and is now `./score/full`: it adds the capability-tag checks (`scenario-tags.ts`, which read `@objectstack/objectql` and `@objectstack/plugin-sharing`) and the card-level `scoreCardArtifact` / `gradeCardOperation` / `gradeCardAnswer`. No score module moved, so #30883 (editing score behaviour in `src/score/**`) does not collide.
3. **Wiring.** `turbo.json`: `@objectstack/scenarios#test` depends on `build` (was `^build`), so the package's own `dist/` exists before its suite runs; `turbo run test --filter=@objectstack/scenarios --dry=json` lists `@objectstack/scenarios#build` as the test's dependency. Any `turbo run build` / `pnpm build` (the root script) now builds the package, which is how a pinned framework tree is built. `docker/Dockerfile` in this repo installs published packages and builds no workspace package, so it needs nothing.

READMEs (`packages/qa/scenarios/README.md`, `docs/qa/scenarios/README.md`) and the `index.ts` header name the two entries.

## Tests

- `test/build/built-consumer.test.ts`: a throwaway package that depends on `@objectstack/scenarios`, imports `scoreGraphShape` statically and `import()`s `@objectstack/scenarios/score`, is built with the repo's tsup (`--format esm,cjs`). The test asserts the bundle keeps the specifier external and does not carry the scorer, then loads `dist/index.js` and `dist/index.cjs` with plain `node`. A preloaded `module.registerHooks` resolve recorder lists every URL the child resolves: the scorer loads from `packages/qa/scenarios/dist/`, nothing from `src/`, nothing matching `objectql` or `plugin-sharing`, and (control) `@objectstack/core` is seen.
- `test/build/narrow-score-graph.test.ts`: walks the source import graph from `src/score/narrow.ts` (type-only imports included) and asserts no `@objectstack/objectql` / `@objectstack/plugin-sharing` specifier, and the exact `@objectstack/*` set it reads. Control: the same walker from `src/score/index.ts` finds both.

## Acceptance notes

- **Surface move inside a private package.** `./score` no longer exports `scoreCardArtifact`, the `scenario-tags` exports, `gradeCardOperation` or `gradeCardAnswer`; they are under `./score/full`. The card's acceptance requires `./score`'s graph to exclude objectql and plugin-sharing, and the two card-level graders live in `index.ts` beside `scoreCardArtifact`, so keeping them in `./score` would have meant moving code out of `index.ts`, which the claim's serial constraint with #30883 rules out. Its only out-of-repo consumer, cloud#3604, reads `scoreGraphShape` and the run grader, both in `./score`.
- **Changeset.** `skip-changeset`: the package is private (the dispatch order's fast lane). Measured: the Check Changeset job (`.github/workflows/pr-automation.yml`) exempts on the label alone and has no private-package branch, so nothing there asks a private package with a build for a changeset. Earlier PRs on this package did carry `'@objectstack/scenarios': patch` changesets (`.changeset/30289-…`, `30291-…`, `30292-…`); `.changeset/config.json` has `privatePackages: { version: true, tag: false }`, so a changeset would only bump the private version.
- **Twin declarations.** tsup emits a `.d.ts` and a `.d.cts` per entry, the simple `packages/lint` pattern, not `packages/core`'s single-declaration pass. The runner exports classes, but no consumer reaches this package through both resolution modes today.

## Verification

All at `e748dfb0a0`, the final head (`origin/main` `26c965cb8f` merged, which brought #30846's loader change).

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios build`: exit 0, `check-dts-emitted: @objectstack/scenarios - 8/8 declared declaration file(s) present.`
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios test`: `Test Files 20 passed (20)`, `Tests 256 passed (256)`. `typecheck`: exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (exit 0) derived 65 commands; all 65 ran, every one exit 0. `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET, no dist for 61 packages) and exited 0 after a whole-tree `turbo run build` (119/119 tasks). `dispatch-gates.mjs --ran`: exit 0, "65 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 65 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED".

<details><summary>Ablation 1: the pre-fix export (`./score` import condition back on src/score/index.ts)</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --file packages/qa/scenarios/package.json --anchor '"default": "./dist/score.js"' --replacement '"default": "./src/score/index.ts"' -- … vitest run test/build/built-consumer.test.ts`: mutation landed (anchor 1 → 0, blob 144f294e → 0d0da83a). Both plain-Node legs red with the card's error, `Error [ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND]: Cannot find module '…/packages/qa/scenarios/src/schema.js' imported from …/src/score/index.ts`. Restored: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation 2: the narrow entry re-exports scenario-tags</summary>

`ablation-replace.mjs --file packages/qa/scenarios/src/score/narrow.ts --anchor "export * from './scenario-graph.js';" --replacement "export { artifactToEvalGraph } from './scenario-graph.js';\nexport * from './scenario-tags.js';"` then `pnpm build`: `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs @objectstack/scenarios "@objectstack/plugin-sharing"` → marker live in dist. `vitest run test/build`: 3 failed | 2 passed (the source-graph leg and both plain-Node legs red; the full-entry control and the external-bundle check stay green). Restored: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty; rebuilt, `grep -c 'plugin-sharing\|objectql'` on `dist/score.js`, `dist/score.cjs`, `dist/score.d.ts` = 0 each, and `test/build` 5/5 green.

</details>
